name: SiftedAI
description:
SiftedAI for Claude helps teams analyze and manage parcel shipping costs using their carrier data. It analyzes invoices, performance metrics, and fees to surface insights about spend, service levels, and cost drivers.

Users can ask questions and get structured answers, visuals, and recommendations. For example, teams can ask why shipping costs increased month over month, where accessorial fees are driving unexpected spend, or what the impact would be if volume shifted to a different carrier.

Finance, operations, and logistics teams use it to identify billing issues, compare carrier performance, run what-if scenarios, and make informed decisions without the manual lift.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SiftedAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SiftedAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sifted.com/agents/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SiftedAI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SiftedAI provides these MCP tools: ask_analyst, ask_platform, get_client_features, get_clients_by_feature, list_available_models, and search_clients.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SiftedAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SiftedAI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SiftedAI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SiftedAI is developed by Sifted. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
